subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word.

As long as I live, I shall be __obliged__ to my Uncle.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Thankless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"obliged"** means to be grateful or indebted for a favor or kindness. (आभारी)

 
 
• **Example:** She felt obliged to help her neighbor after receiving so much support from them.
 
 
 
• **"Thankless"** refers to being ungrateful or lacking appreciation for something that was done for you. (अकृतज्ञ)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite all her efforts, her thankless attitude made her parents feel unappreciated.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'obliged' **is **'thankless'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Thankless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Grateful** (आभारी): Feeling or showing appreciation for kindness or benefits received.

 
 
• **Example:** I am grateful to my teachers for their guidance and support.
 
 
 
• **Pleased** (प्रसन्न): Feeling happy or satisfied about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was pleased with the results of her hard work.
 
 
 
• **Indebted** (ऋणी): Owing gratitude for a favor or service received.
 
 
• **Example:** I feel indebted to my friends for their constant support during tough times.
